description:
If you’re dreaming of taking your off-road riding experience to the next level, consider the newly designed and customizable Beast Mode FS enduro trail bike.

Utlilizing 160 mm of travel in front, and 150 mm of travel in the rear, the Beast Mode FS features a Short-Link Four Bar design with an idealized Instant Center of Rotation (IC) for excellent small bump compliance, rising rate mid-stroke support, and a progressive leverage rate to take on those big hits deep into the Beast Mode FS’s suspension.

Aiding in the development of the Beast Mode FS was the use of Linkage Professional computer software, which was used to analyze suspension kinematics. This allowed the Beast Mode FS's design to be optimized for improved pedaling efficiency, less energy waste due to pedal squat, improved braking, and enhanced suspension characteristics.

Complementing the Beast Mode FS’s solid kinematics, is Quiring’s application of progressive trail geometry, or in other words, a long, low and slack frame layout. We have created an enduro trail bike with a shorter chainstay (16.9"), a longer top tube (customizable to rider's needs), steeper seat angle (74 degrees), a shorter headtube (customizable to rider's needs), and a slacker head angle (67 degrees), to tackle those rowdy downhills with confidence, while improving the climbing ability when riding up steeper hills.

What all this means is that with the Beast Mode FS you get a package which is efficient to pedal to the top of climbs yet is ready to shred all those fun downhills!

Lightweight, responsive, and durable titanium frame construction throughout, with rider tuned tubing diameters, available for riders of all sizes.

Short-Link Four Bar design to allow for shorter 16.9 inch long chainstays, which results in improved rear tire traction and a more playful bike.

Proprietary CNC machined from billet chainstay yokes and linkages for stiffness and maximum tire clearance for Plus bikes.

Ultilizing Progressive Trail FS geometry based on long, low, and slack dimensions. Tested in real world conditions.

Optimized design in Linkage Pro computer software.

100% machined, TIG welded, and painted in the U.S.A. by Scott Quiring and crew at Quiring Cycles, LLC World Headquarters located in Free Soil, Michigan, U.S.A., which has a history of building high-end frames for almost two decades.

Compatiable with standardized industry shocks to include high end rear shocks like Cane Creek’s DBairIL (air shock with LSR/HSR and LSC/HSC adjustments), Fox Float DPS (3 pos air shock), Fox Float DPX2 (air shock available with LSR/HSR and LSC/HSC adjustments), Fox Float X2 (coil shock available with LSR/HSR and LSC/HSC adjustments) and other popular coil shocks.

Quad precision bearing design used in lower pivots for long life and durability.

Headtube size available in 1.5” for Angleset headsets or standard 1.5” headsets. Use of an Angleset headset allows a stock headtube angle to be adjusted by up to +/- 1.5 degrees, thereby allowing riders to make changes to the aggressiveness of the headtube angle and ride character of the Beast Mode FS's Progressive Trail geometry.
